placeholders: Ask a question or describe a task...

resume: （自动续跑）继续。上一轮中断了。
如果你记得刚才在做什么，先看看做到哪一步，从那里接着做，别从头来。
如果不记得，下面是我中断前发的消息，照它做：
resumeNoTask: （自动续跑）继续。上一轮中断了。先看看刚才做到哪一步，从那里接着做，别从头来。
restart: （自动续跑）继续。Kiro 刚才重启了，上一轮被打断，你开的终端和后台进程可能都没了。
如果你记得刚才在做什么，先看看做到哪一步，从那里接着做，别从头来。
如果不记得，下面是我中断前发的消息，照它做：
restartNoTask: （自动续跑）继续。Kiro 刚才重启了，上一轮被打断，你开的终端和后台进程可能都没了。先看看刚才做到哪一步，从那里接着做，别从头来。
contract: （做到完）这个会话请一直做到目标全部完成，中间不要停下来问我。
要定的事按你推荐的定，每个决定都写进最后的汇报（项目里有记待办的文档，也记一笔），然后接着做。
不要问「要不要做下一步」，直接做。
只在两种情况下停，并且在最后一行单独写标记：
全部做完了，对照目标逐条核对过，该跑的检查都跑过：{done}
碰到只有我本人能做的事（出素材、试玩、给密钥、付钱，或者删数据、推送、发布这类收不回来的事）：{stuck}，后面写原因
push: （做到完）继续，按你的判断往下做，别问我。全部做完写{done}，只有我本人能做的事写{stuck}加原因。
pushGoal: （做到完）继续，按你的判断往下做，别问我。目标还是：
全部做完写{done}，只有我本人能做的事写{stuck}加原因。
verify: （做到完）收尾前核对一遍：把目标逐条列出来，每条写做到没有、怎么验证的。没做完的就接着做；都做完了，最后一行再写{done}。

help: 帮助
说明
您可以这样操作：
发送『状态』查看所有会话，每个会话都有编号
发送『续 2』让2号会话继续执行
发送『停 2』让2号会话停下，和在电脑上点停止一样
发送『2 加上任务说明』把这段话发给2号会话；2号正在执行的话先排队，这一轮做完再发
发送『清 2』取消排队等待发送到2号会话的消息
发送『新 项目名称 加任务内容』在这个项目里开启新会话并发送这段话；只开着一个Kiro窗口时可以不写项目名称
支持文字命令，语音消息也能自动转成文字

resume: (auto-continue) Continue. The last turn was interrupted.
If you remember what you were doing, check how far you got and pick up from there; do not start over.
If you do not, this is the message I sent before the interruption; do what it asks:
resumeNoTask: (auto-continue) Continue. The last turn was interrupted. Check how far you got and pick up from there; do not start over.
restart: (auto-continue) Continue. Kiro just restarted and the last turn was interrupted; terminals and background processes you started may be gone.
If you remember what you were doing, check how far you got and pick up from there; do not start over.
If you do not, this is the message I sent before the interruption; do what it asks:
restartNoTask: (auto-continue) Continue. Kiro just restarted and the last turn was interrupted; terminals and background processes you started may be gone. Check how far you got and pick up from there; do not start over.
contract: (until-done) Keep working in this session until the goal is fully done. Do not stop to ask me.
Make the calls yourself, choosing what you would recommend, and list every decision in your final report (and in the project's to-do notes, if it keeps any).
Do not ask whether to do the next step; do it.
Stop in only two cases, and put the mark alone on the last line:
Everything is done, checked against the goal item by item, with the checks run: {done}
Something only I can do (provide assets, play-test, give a key, pay, or anything hard to undo such as deleting data, pushing or publishing): {stuck} followed by the reason
push: (until-done) Continue, and decide for yourself; do not ask me. Write {done} when everything is done, or {stuck} with the reason if only I can do the next part.
pushGoal: (until-done) Continue, and decide for yourself; do not ask me. The goal is still:
Write {done} when everything is done, or {stuck} with the reason if only I can do the next part.
verify: (until-done) Before you finish, check once: list the goal item by item, and for each say whether it is done and how you verified it. Do whatever is not done; when all of it is, write {done} on the last line again.

help: help
h
You can send:
status: what each session is doing, each with a number
continue 2: have #2 carry on
stop 2: stop #2, as the stop button does
2 and some text: type that text into session #2, as if you typed it at the PC; while #2 is running it waits its turn and goes in once that turn is done
clear 2: drop what is waiting to go into #2
new my_project and some text: open a new session in my_project with that text (with one Kiro window open, the workspace can be left out)
Only text, or voice (WeCom turns it into text)
remote.textOnly: Only text, please. Voice works too: WeCom turns it into text.

remote.newOpening: Got it, opening a new session in {ws}...
remote.newOpenedNoNumber: Opened in {ws}; send "status" for its number.
remote.newNoText: Add what it should do, for example "new {ws} find out why the tests fail".
